Slower support replies mean unhappier customers: satisfaction drops from 4.4/5 when resolved in under 4 hours to just 1.7/5 when it takes more than 3 days.
A big chunk of support tickets (~65% recently) are shoppers asking "where's my order" - and this spikes every November/December, matching a rise in late deliveries from ~4% to ~10%+ of shipments.

One merchant's May 2025 delivery breakdown (70% of shipments took over a week, vs. under 5% normally) explains an unusual mid-year spike in slow support - it was a local incident, not a platform-wide issue.
